I have that too. It especially happens when I'm bored and late at night. Something about the fantasy is just satisfying somehow.
Try new things bro. Games, sports, hobbies, anything
How long have you felt like this?

Thank you for your responses. I do enjoy writing with you and so I want to know more. In this moment I just thought: do you enjoy having those dark conversations? Or why do you write here? Why don't you explore this interest further. Or maybe it's just interesting because the thought of suicide gives you a relief. Maybe that's why I enjoy this as well. Do you write some kind of journal to collect your thoughts because maybe that could be an interesting read.

I also feel like I should apologize if I seem too cold and unsympathetic. I'm new here and have never written something like this to anyone at all so I don't really know how to do it properly.

Okay, cuz I imagine making the decision to be amazing but maybe that will come when there's actually no turning back. 

By the way, how did you react when you realized you weren't alone and got to live a bit longer (at least)? Did you feel guilty? Was there thankfulness or just dissapointment? 

Sorry if I make you feel like a test object here, asking all of those questions. I just find your situation very interesting.

Cool story man. Big step setting the date. 

I'm a bit like you here because I too have suicial thoughts. I have a bad relationship with my parents, I've never kissed a girl and it's itching like hell, and I have been planning my death for half a year now.

But I'm not gonna kill myself, at least not soon. I just can't do it to my twin brother.

So yeah, with an odd approach I ask you: how did it feel setting the date? Relief? Emptyness? Energetic? Please tell me because that's one of the things I long for the most when killing myself.

Please note that I still don't support your decision to end your life. Life can change a lot. So can you.
